ctx.x: Yeah, well J. J. for one. You know, J. J. was one of the biggest -- he was really a junkie. But I admired him because he beat it and he was a perfect gentleman, and straight ahead, you know, you know. But any way, these were beautiful days, and so I left there and I think I joined Slam again. And then I worked Bop City with Slam.
